name: Winter Showcase (Winter Formal)
type: Competitive Showcase Jan 7–8 (solo, trio, PITCH) + Informal Performance Showcase Jan 9–10 (her classes)
notes: Competitive Showcase Thu–Fri Jan 7–8 (Sofia most likely Fri Jan 8); Informal Performance Showcase Sat–Sun Jan 9–10 (her classes). The Informal is opt-out only: she performs unless you email your location's front desk by Sat Nov 7). Shows run all day by age division; each class does a 1–1.5 min mini routine, all classes or none. Tee shirt size by Nov 7 on the studio website's home page. What to wear for the classes: the winter performance tee + solid black bottoms; ballet: pink tights, pink ballet shoes and a solid black leotard. Several classes: layer (black leggings over pink convertible tights) and change shoes only: no changing rooms, no time for full changes. Must be back for rehearsals Sat Jan 2. Treat it as the dress rehearsal for the January comps. UPDATE from La's Nov 12 email: the Competitive Showcase is now an on-stage dress rehearsal for the GROUP routines only (about 15 minutes each, full costume, hair and makeup), open to immediate family only. Solos, duos and trios do NOT take the stage before competition season; their in-studio run on Dec 6 or Dec 12 is their dress rehearsal. The studio's emails and sheets give Jan 8–10 only; days and call times are not announced.
cost: $60 participation fee (winter performance tee + the performance video); tickets $10 each
fun: Season kickoff! Everyone at Glass House performs, and it's the first time the solo, trio and PITCH dances are seen by an audience. Rehearsal Sat Jan 2 is a must.
